Rich but coherent detail, no surrounding badge, no words, no other digit. FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC square image; full object centered with generous 8% clear margins, no cropped tips. Genuinely transparent background including internal openings; no white backdrop or checkerboard pixels, no external cast shadow. Preserve the mask's identity and the numeral's readability together.
